narrative.overview: A cool neutral workspace with white navigation and panels, graphite typography, near-black actions, blue interaction cues, and restrained rules. It follows the user-selected visual character of the reference product through an original, semantic, white-label-ready implementation.
keyCharacteristics: Cool off-white application field with white navigation and work surfaces.
Inter typography throughout the operational interface.
Graphite primary actions and blue interaction cues.
Pale gray active navigation with accessible text contrast.
Tenant palettes continue to flow through validated semantic tokens.

rules.name: The Black Action Rule
rules.body: Primary actions use graphite rather than a bright brand fill.

rules.name: The Blue Interaction Rule
rules.body: Blue communicates interaction or state, never passive decoration.

rules.name: The Contrast Gate Rule
rules.body: Tenant palettes must pass semantic text and focus contrast validation.

dos: Keep dense operational information calm and scannable.
Use the shared semantic tokens on client, admin, designer, and authentication surfaces.
Keep tenant branding data-driven and contrast validated.
Use visible focus, labelled controls, and text-first status.
donts: Do not reintroduce orange or coral as the default theme.
Do not use a dark default navigation rail.
Do not copy proprietary source or assets from the reference product.
Do not use low-contrast gray text or decorative action glows.
